Welcome to B Diamond Physio—where Balanced Riders create Balanced Horses.

At B Diamond Physio, we bridge the gap between rider and horse performance, through specialized physiotherapy and equine physio. Based in Alberta, we help equestrians ride better and perform pain-free—in and out of the saddle.

On this channel, you’ll find:
🐴 Rider biomechanics tips & exercises
💪 Equine physio and rehab insights
🏇 Warm-up routines for horse & rider
🎓 Educational clips from Ride Right Clinics
🌿 Real-world case studies and physio success stories

Whether you’re a weekend rider or a competitive athlete, our mission is to help you and your horse move in harmony, prevent injury and achieve long-term performance.

BALANCED RIDERS. BALANCED HORSES. 
Subscribe for new videos on rider strength, balance, mobility and equine wellness: learn how small changes in your body can make a big difference in your horse.

#BDiamondPhysio #EquestrianPhysiotherapy #HorseAndRiderBalance #RiderBiomechanics #RideRight
